description: [alias of cuba_calibrar] Bayesian confidence calibration: track verify predictions, mark outcomes, compute P(correct|level). Closes the feedback loop between faro verify and eco correct.

action.description: stats/history: past predictions. resolve: mark a verify_id correct/incorrect. trust: per-source Beta(α, β) credibility, updated by resolve outcomes. metrics: Brier score + Expected Calibration Error + reliability diagram.

outcome.description: Whether the verify prediction was right (for resolve)

name: memory_calibrar
